items.duty_text: Organize and conduct an investigation of discrimination in employment for a period of one year, including testing local employers with matched-pair testers.
Organize and conduct a one-year investigation of discrimination in housing accommodation services, including testing local housing accommodation providers with matched pairs of testers.
Take all actions necessary for implementation, including promulgation of rules, before the local law takes effect.
Make the climate survey available to all agencies for dissemination to agency employees.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Refer incidents of actual or perceived discrimination occurring during the investigation to the commission’s law enforcement bureau.
State its findings of fact and conclusions of law.
Issue and cause to be served on the respondent an order requiring the respondent to cease and desist from unlawful discriminatory practices or acts of discriminatory harassment or violence.

Apply the highest hourly market-rate fee charged by attorneys of similar skill and experience within all jurisdictions located within the city when determining a reasonable hourly rate for a complainant’s attorney’s fee award based on the attorney’s hourly rate.

To receive, investigate and pass upon complaints and to initiate its own investigation of group tensions, prejudice, intolerance, bigotry and disorder occasioned thereby, and unlawful discrimination against any person or group of persons.
Upon its own motion, to make, sign and file complaints alleging violations of the city’s human rights law.
To work together with federal, state and city agencies in developing courses of instruction and to engage in other anti-discrimination activities.

To develop courses of instruction and conduct ongoing public education efforts as necessary to inform employers, employment agencies and job applicants about their rights and responsibilities under specified provisions concerning discrimination on the basis of unemployment.

To develop courses of instruction and conduct ongoing public education efforts as necessary to inform four-plus employers, employees, employment agencies and job applicants about their rights and responsibilities under section 8-2055 of the administrative code.
Create an anti-sexual harassment rights and responsibilities poster meeting the specified minimum content requirements.
Make the required poster available on the commission’s website for employers to download for legible color reproduction.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Develop an information sheet on sexual harassment containing at least the same elements as the poster and make it available in English and Spanish.
Develop a climate survey to assess awareness and knowledge of workplace sexual harassment policies and prevention at city agencies.

The commission shall not have jurisdiction over complaints filed more than one year after the alleged unlawful discriminatory practice or act occurred, except that it shall have jurisdiction over qualifying gender-based harassment claims filed within three years after the alleged harassing conduct occurred.
Create a model lactation policy and a model lactation space request form in collaboration with the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, and make them available on its website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Engage in outreach and education efforts regarding the rights of current and prospective employees and the responsibilities of employers established by this local law.
Develop and disseminate a written notice of protections related to lawful source of income, and make it available to the Department of Social Services for use under § 21-141.1.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Include informational resources on age discrimination as part of regular outreach and education efforts, including creating a poster describing age discrimination, providing examples of prohibited conduct, explaining how to file a complaint, and including information on additional resources.
Make additional resources on age discrimination available on the commission’s website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Refer incidents of actual or perceived discrimination that occur during the investigation to the commission’s law enforcement bureau.
Initiate its own investigation of qualifying past conduct by current or former NYPD employees.
Investigate qualifying past official conduct from the employee’s hiring date through the applicable end date.
Make, sign, and file an administrative complaint upon its own motion alleging violations discovered during an investigation.
Refer qualifying pattern-or-practice information to the corporation counsel for a civil action.
Initiate and undertake investigations in accordance with applicable chapter and charter requirements, including recordkeeping requirements.
Investigate all work and cases handled by the NYPD Equal Employment Opportunity Division between September 1, 2014 and November 30, 2020.

mandates.duty_text: Submit a report to the speaker of the council related to the employment investigation conducted during the prior 12-month period, including specified testing and discrimination information.
Submit a report to the Speaker of the Council concerning the housing accommodation investigation conducted during the prior 12-month period, including specified testing and discrimination data.
Prepare and submit a report to the mayor and the speaker with the results of the climate survey.
Produce a report to the mayor and the speaker with the results of the redistributed climate survey.
To report to the secretary of state of New York all violations of article 1 of subchapter 2 of chapter 2 of title 8 of the administrative code by real estate brokers and salespersons.

To issue publications and reports of investigation and research designed to promote good will and minimize or eliminate prejudice, intolerance, bigotry, discrimination and disorder occasioned thereby.
Submit to the speaker of the council a report related to the aging investigation conducted during the prior 12 month period, including the specified testing and discrimination information.
